LESSON: TAQWA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Taqwa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Taqwa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What actions lead to piety?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Taqwa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Taqwa in the examples.
2. Explain Taqwa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Taqwa.
4. Show that you can: identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Taqwa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Taqwa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read verses (Q. 2: 2-5, 3:133-135) from the Qur’an/digital devices /mus’haf and list down the qualities of mutaqiin,
2. Match and sort the qualities of a pious person using flash cards,
3. Search online/from a mus’haf/ verse (Q.2:43: 76, 7:96, 9:119, 19:72,) on taqwa and draw their significance,
4. Digital Literacy: interacting with digital technology as learners search online verses (Q.2:43: 76, 7:96, 9:119, 19:72,) on taqwa and draw their significance.
5. Critical thinking and problem solving: researching skills as learners draw the significance of taqwa from the given verses of the Qur’an Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What actions lead to piety?
2. Why is taqwa important in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
